facts.business: Keerthi Industries Limited operates in the cement and electronics sectors, having transferred its Electronics Division to a related party via slump sale on 31st March 2026, with the cement business as continuing operations.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: Current liabilities exceed current assets by Rs. 5379 Lakhs as at 31st March 2026; delayed payments to overdue creditors; continued losses due to lower operating volumes and industry conditions. Financial statements prepared on going concern basis based on management's assessment of adequate cash flows and funding.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to accumulated losses and current liabilities exceeding current assets by Rs. 5379 Lakhs
Lower operating volumes and adverse industry conditions
Uncertain tax positions involving significant judgment
Dependence on management's ability to generate adequate cash flows and arrange funding
facts.related_party_note: Electronics Division transferred via Business Transfer Agreement (BTA) to Keerthi Holdings Pvt. Ltd. (formerly Hyderabad Bottling Co. Pvt. Ltd.), a related party, as a going concern by way of slump sale completed on 31st March 2026.
